subject: prd/implement-now
statement: Which attribution primitive authenticates the impl-review-owned broker's native receipt plus attempt/proposal/revision proof without exposing raw material or canonical-state write capability to either child role? Before that primitive can be chosen, the live sibling contract and design must explicitly authorize the host-side impl-review persistence adapter to perform `prd:impl-review/FR-6` for the reviewer program and expose exactly-one publication returning the native receipt; implement-now supplies binding and consumes the receipt but cannot transfer or duplicate that write. Code-host author identity is explicitly outside the predicate.
intent: impl-review sibling amendment/design + superseding implement-now design
rationale: blocked — absent or ambiguous performer authority, receipt-returning capability, or exactly-once semantics, and any ownership or performer transfer, requires a sibling impl-review amendment and design before code; only then may design choose the proof primitive
